Download academic PDFs through authorized institutional access, library proxies, local browser profiles, or cloud browser sessions without storing credentials.

通过学校/机构已授权访问、图书馆代理、本地浏览器登录态或云端浏览器会话下载学术 PDF，不保存账号密码。
